name: Siona Rufus
source:
The Deceitful Wolf

The object of Rayen's desires after an encounter with her early in the year. On the surface, she appears to be a beautiful, exemplary student that is well-liked by everyone. Perhaps there is more to her than meets the eye...

Hobbies: Social events, being around boys?
